title: Security workflow, GitHub Actions rules and Dependabot
summary: security.yml in two tiers (enforcing: gitleaks and the project gate; advisory: Semgrep, Trivy, an SBOM), scanners pinned by checksum, guards GA-1/GA-2 (SHA-pinned actions, zizmor at zero) and a Dependabot skeleton.
postInstall: Call security.yml from your CI workflow as its first job, so a red gate turns CI red: the ci-workflow module installs a skeleton that does, or add the call to your own (snippet: docs/conventions/security-workflow.md § Wiring). Until then its enforcing job only runs on the weekly schedule, on manual dispatch and on docs-only pushes.
Add the project's package ecosystems to .github/dependabot.yml (the TODO(harness) block shows the shape).
Run ./scripts/security-checks.sh once with network access: GA-2 fetches the pinned zizmor. Fix what it reports on your existing workflows, or record the triage in .github/zizmor.yml.
Scanner pins (gitleaks, Trivy, Syft, Semgrep, zizmor) are bumped by hand: docs/conventions/security-workflow.md § Pinned scanners. Dependabot does not see them.
